product.olivetti-philos-45.summary: The Philos 45 from the range expansion announced at CeBIT 1994.
product.olivetti-philos-45.history: Olivetti expanded its business notebook range with the Philos 45, 46 and 48 at CeBIT 1994. MCmicrocomputer identifies the 45 among the new models.
product.olivetti-philos-45.architecture: The processor distinguishes configurations in the sources. MCmicrocomputer reported 33 MHz and Clous documented a unit with a 25 MHz i486SL.
product.olivetti-philos-45.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-45.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
